title: Ventilation.
officialText:
Nonproduction laboratories shall be ventilated in accordance with Section 407 of the New York City Mechanical
Code.
SECTION BC 425
USES AND OCCUPANCIES INVOLVING
RADIOACTIVE MATERIALS AND
RADIATION-PRODUCING EQUIPMENT
